milestones.title: Initialize independent Command Center app, CI and deployment
scope: Initialize independent Command Center app with strict SDK/package version pinning.
Configure build, lint, tests, preview/release and environment validation.
Keep application data routes separate from Academy learning schema.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: App builds/deploys independently, consumes version-pinned SDK.
verification: Command Center deploys without bundling Academy code or secrets.
Breaking engine contract surfaces release failure before traffic shifts.

milestones.title: Professional design theme and common tool renderer
scope: Define compact professional tokens with restrained 4-6px radii, stronger density and consistent controls.
Render canonical domain tools with no forked business logic or educational overlays.
Create accessible responsive desktop-first shell with theme/pane semantics.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Sharp 4–6px radii, tighter spacing; tool behavior matches Academy.
verification: Same test tool yields same artifact data in both apps.
Visual regression verifies compact treatment and absence of education components.

milestones.title: Shared identity, projects and entitlement validation
scope: Implement shared account, organization selection, entitlements and safe app switching.
Open canonical Academy projects using engine API and preserve revisions/permission scopes.
Support deep links for project, artifact and saved workflow.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: An Academy project opens intact with matching artifacts and access policies.
verification: Academy-authored project reopens with exact revision graph and files.
Changing org scope invalidates unauthorized deep links.

milestones.title: Dense project explorer, history and artifact inspector
scope: Build dense persistent project navigator with history, file/artifact tree and search.
Add revision inspector, lineage metadata, pinned views and bulk select controls.
Support fast keyboard traversal and optimistic but conflict-safe metadata editing.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Quick project navigation, structured versions and files work reliably.
verification: Open, search and inspect large multi-artifact project quickly.
User cannot navigate into another organization's hidden artifacts.

milestones.title: Searchable tool launcher, favorites and keyboard command palette
scope: Implement universal command palette, tool search, favorites and recents.
Bind every command to permitted live capability and preserve saved project context.
Support shortcuts and intelligent no-results/unavailable states.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: All enabled capabilities are reachable without navigating other provider sites.
verification: User launches every enabled workspace without provider-site navigation.
Revoked/unavailable capability is hidden or disabled with reason.

milestones.title: Resizable panes and saved domain workspace layouts
scope: Add keyboard-resizable dock panels, split views and configurable workspace regions.
Persist per-tool/user/device layout with accessible reset and sensible mobile fallback.
Allow opening two artifact inspectors without duplicating underlying project state.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Persistent layout per device/tool with keyboard accessibility.
verification: Layout survives refresh and app switching on same device.
Keyboard resizing and restoring defaults work without pointer input.

milestones.title: Unified job tray, background status and reattach
scope: Build global concurrent run tray for pending/running/approved/completed operations.
Reattach to persisted events after tab close and offer safe cancel/retry where supported.
Expose source project, elapsed time, provider state and reconciled cost.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Jobs can be inspected/cancelled/reattached after closing/reopening the app.
verification: A long-running provider job remains inspectable after relaunch.
Cancelled/failed job status matches worker state rather than optimistic UI.

milestones.title: Power model selection, comparisons and routing policy
scope: Create advanced model selection with capability filters, vendor-specific options and profile presets.
Offer cost/latency/rights comparison and model pinning where a user is entitled.
Display router decision trace and clear no-compatible-provider failure.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: User can pin provider when available and see cost/policy constraints.
verification: Pinned provider is honored or refused explicitly, never silently changed.
A commercial-rights restriction rules out incompatible media provider.

milestones.title: Batch actions and concurrent workflow execution
scope: Implement bounded batch submission, concurrency settings and budget previews.
Support pause/cancel/retry of individual tasks while preserving successful outputs.
Enforce global/user/project caps and show independent job results.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Selected artifacts run in bounded batches with correct budgets and outcomes.
verification: Batch of mixed success/failure preserves successful asset revisions.
Parallel jobs cannot bypass spend or rate limits.

milestones.title: Goal templates and output checklist composer
scope: Build goal template selector for film, legislation and custom cross-tool deliverable packages.
Provide output-checkbox composer and preview of workflow, cost and dependencies.
Allow targeted regeneration of selected output artifacts after human review.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Legislative and film package outputs can be toggled and DAG previewed.
verification: Film and bill checklists generate different typed DAGs as intended.
Unselected outputs are not generated or billed.

milestones.title: Artifact compare, restore and provenance inspector
scope: Create side-by-side artifact/version diff and revision comparison across supported media.
Show model, prompt/tool, source and license provenance in inspector.
Implement non-destructive restore as a new revision, including audit history.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Revisions and source lineage are human-readable; reversion is non-destructive.
verification: Restore revision without deleting later versions.
Differences and parent/source metadata stay legible for mixed media.

milestones.title: Saved reusable recipes, presets and project templates
scope: Enable versioned workflow recipes, workspace presets and reusable project starters.
Parameterize typed inputs, credential scopes, budgets and model pin rules.
Negotiate recipe/tool versions and support preview before executing.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Reusable workflows preserve typed inputs and perform version negotiation.
verification: Save, share authorized template and rerun with different inputs.
Deprecated provider or schema produces migration guidance, not silent corruption.

milestones.title: Team project sharing and permission-scoped collaboration
scope: Build organization member invitation, per-project sharing and artifact permissions UI.
Include least-privilege collaborator roles, expiring share grants and audit history.
Support revocation and effective-access introspection across both apps.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Grant and revoke access at project/artifact level with audit trace.
verification: Revoked invitee loses file and workflow access immediately.
Artifact-only grant does not expose sibling projects.

milestones.title: Subscription, usage, credits and BYOK configuration
scope: Implement subscription/credit dashboards and payment-account links using engine entitlements.
Create BYOK setup with server-side encrypted storage and provider-term restrictions.
Display real usage and remaining caps with exportable cost statements.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: No provider keys exposed; UI matches engine billing records.
verification: Provider key never appears in client build, URL or logs.
BYOK job remains subject to tool permissions and hard ceilings.

milestones.title: Business accounts, seats, policies and audit panel
scope: Add organization seats, admin roles, approval policy and department-level spend caps.
Provide audit inspector for membership, data exports, tool actions and deployment permissions.
Enforce policies server-side rather than trusting disabled interface controls.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Org roles and spend policies enforce server-side limits.
verification: Removed seat cannot invoke previously available paid model.
Org-level cap prevents authorized individual from overspending.

milestones.title: Data exports, retention controls and support tooling
scope: Create one-click export for sources, generated media, revisions and manifest.
Provide retention preferences, deletion requests and legal hold status where applicable.
Equip permission-scoped support to resolve export failures without direct secret access.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: User can download/export project and request deletion with documented results.
verification: Exported bundle passes manifest hash and dependency checks.
Deletion processes report completion/exception without misleading users.

milestones.title: Performance budget, error resilience and accessibility
scope: Optimize large-project navigation, artifact rendering and streamed jobs under measured workloads.
Provide offline/unavailable states, recovery controls, screen-reader and keyboard QA.
Set performance budgets and verify mobile/desktop accessibility.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Critical journeys pass keyboard/screen reader and production performance checks.
verification: Large synthetic project loads within documented performance budget.
Network interruption does not duplicate runs or silently lose edits.

milestones.title: Zero-lesson footprint compliance and visual parity tests
scope: Build automated bundle/route scanner to exclude Academy lesson, tutor, course and marketing modules.
Remove hint triggers, teaching overlays and education-specific network calls.
Compare identical shared tool workflow behavior between Command Center and Academy.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: No Academy educational script, tooltip nudge or paid-course upsell leaks into Command Center.
verification: Compiled Command Center bundles and UI routes contain no instructional features.
One shared tool operates identically in both shells without duplicated implementation.

milestones.title: Live end-to-end tests, release and rollback acceptance
scope: Deploy Command Center with confirmed source SHA, environment and rollback notes.
Run production E2E for identity, cross-app artifacts, IDE, media, billing, BYOK and approvals.
Record security, a11y, performance and alerting evidence with real service status.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Real service readiness and app switching validated at deployed SHAs.
verification: Cross-app deep link, real model generation and provider spend reconciliation pass deployed checks.
Wrong Render project, stale SHA or incomplete backup prevents sign-off.
